blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine government expects to open applications for its long-awaited Electric Vehicle Incentive Strategy (Evis) by January 2027, as it moves to attract automotive manufacturers and build a domestic industry for electric vehicles (EVs). Trade Undersecretary Ceferino Rodolfo said the program’s implementing rules and regulations (IRR) were in the final stages of preparation, […]... Keep on reading: Perks for EV makers roll out in Jan
